name: Trees
description: Trees word search puzzles gather common tree names and woodland English for adults and seniors — oak, maple, birch, canopy, foliage, acorn and bark words — without park-agency brands or licensed forest characters. Every grid is free online with no download, no account and no timer. Choose easy across-and-down warm-ups, medium grids with diagonals, hard puzzles in all eight directions, or large print with bigger letters on a smaller board. The list stays rooted and unhurried: cedar, beech, aspen, branch and autumn vocabulary walkers already recognize. This hub pairs well with Forests and Garden when you want a longer green-path session. Prefer bigger type? Start with large print. New solvers can read how to play, then pick a difficulty as steady as a shaded trail.
